subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

There are others waiting to grab an opportunity; if you don’t act fast, you are going to ________.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4' i.e. **'miss the boat'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom** "miss the boat"** means to miss an opportunity or to fail to take advantage of a chance.(किसी अवसर को चूक जाना या अवसर का लाभ उठाने में असफल होना)
 
• It is the most fitting choice in this context where urgency and the risk of losing an opportunity are highlighted.

Therefore, the correct answer is- *There are others waiting to grab an opportunity; if you don’t act fast, you are going to **miss the boat.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **be in the same boat:** This idiom is used to indicate that people are in the same situation, usually a difficult one.
 
• **a full boat:** As mentioned, it is not an established idiom in English.
 
• **push the boat out: **This is used when someone decides to spend a lot of money on a celebration or to be generous/extensive in some form of expenditure.
